description: This PHP source file defines the class actionSendEmail, which extends a base class actionBase, and handles sending emails within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for loading JavaScript, displaying email-related UI, extracting email addresses from parameters, running the email sending action, parsing email templates, retrieving email attachments, and sending email via SMTP with attachments. The file also manages email success/failure counters and interacts with related entities such as email templates and notes.

classes.name: actionSendEmail
classes.description: Represents an action to send emails within the SuiteCRM workflow system, encompassing methods for preparing, executing, and managing email dispatches with support for templates and attachments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the actionSendEmail object and resetting email status counters.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the list of JavaScript files required for UI functionality.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML content for editing email send actions in the workflow UI, including options for templates and email addresses.

methods.name: getEmailsFromParams
methods.description: Extracts email addresses and related info from provided parameters based on target types.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the email-sending process based on the provided bean and parameters, updating success and failure counters.

methods.name: clearLastEmailsStatus
methods.description: Resets internal counters for last email send attempt.

methods.name: getLastEmailsFailed
methods.description: Returns the count of failed email sends from the last run.

methods.name: getLastEmailsSuccess
methods.description: Returns the count of successfully sent emails from the last run.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in email templates with related bean data and URLs for contextual emails.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments related to a specific email template.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email with attachments using SugarPHPMailer and records the email in system logs, also copying attachment files as needed.
